basic_info.description: Impeccably maintained and tastefully updated, this top-floor Mid-Century condo offers sweeping panoramic views of the San Francisco skyline paired with refined, modern finishes throughout. The spacious one-bedroom, one-bath layout features an airy open floor plan bathed in natural light, ideal for both relaxed living and effortless entertaining. The sleek kitchen is appointed with quartz countertops, premium stainless steel appliances, and a generous center island that seamlessly connects to the open-concept living and dining areas. A private balcony with/ double sliding doors provides the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee while taking in city views. The oversized bedroom easily accommodates a king-size bed and features a walk-in closet with additional space for a home office, complete with serene greenbelt outlooks. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, a second walk-in closet, two-car parking, and additional detached storage. Set in an exceptionally well-maintained building with low HOA dues, this home offers a rare combination of comfort, style, and convenience with easy access to transportation and the best of city living.
